sourceMethod: Follows the official centers, common-chord midpoint, and X construction with similar right triangles. It justifies the center separation without relying on the source diagram and expresses the final sine relation as a similar-triangle height ratio.

review.mathCheck: The inscribed angle and chord give radius 3, with chord distances 3/2 and 13/2. Center separation 8 would require O1P=√55>7, so separation is 5 and O1P=4. Similarity gives O1X=65/8, XP=33/8 and height 33/10. Thus the area is \(99\sqrt3/20\), giving 122, choice D.
